properties.site-address: North of Station House, Christon Bank
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Narrow, linear site adjacent to railway line (ECML) at Christon Bank. Currently occupied for caravan storage but capable of supporting a residential development of a limited size if pursued for redevelopment. Identified yield of homes reflective of physical characteristics of the site. The site is largely outwith the settlement boundary identified in the draft neighbourhood plan, with the remainder proposed for allocation for community uses. The current availability of the site is uncertain. No residential development is forecast within the plan period at present.
